title: Manufactured solutions for conduction on every fitting
headline: L2 error falls on all 16 fittings; 5 converge at the straight's order, the rest reported

references.source: manufactured: $T_m = \sin(a x + 0.3)\,\sin(b y + 0.7)\,\sin(c z + 1.1)$, source $S = (a^2 + b^2 + c^2)\,T_m$

toolchain.conversion: gmshToFoam, with -keepOrientation when the worst scaled Jacobian is positive (task 0108)

gates.quantity: volume-weighted L2 error of T, every case
gates.limit: falls with refinement (orders reported, not gated)

lessons.text: Next to sloped or kinked walls OpenFOAM's fixedValue wall gradient is first order at any refinement: expect order about 1 there (tee 1.03, reducer 0.95), while code_saturne on the same meshes holds 1.85-2.0; it isn't the mesh.
refined(k) caps a wye's n_split, so its split region isn't refined and its order stays low in both OpenFOAM and code_saturne (0.27-0.51 at k 2 to 4).
